name: axHub handoff
author: Brett
description: The hub's Claude handoff results inside the console (admins): every handoff run, one run's live progress with its gauges and step groups, the prompt with a session picker (claude.ai, Claude Code on each platform, copy), and the kit's files to read or download, through the console's hub-pages relay. Not the Claude handoff plugin (Tools → Claude handoff), which builds the kit; this shows what the hub received. Module axHub (the hub's own pages inside the console, folded from apps/axhub-web Nov 20 2026). Only a wall admin's browser may use it; uninstalling it removes only these pages.
